note: Cloudflare Web Analytics (ADR-0096). Mode off: no script, the privacy words say there is no page analytics. Mode auto: Cloudflare adds its script itself (the dashboard option Enable, excluding visitor data in the EU, when excludeEu is true); the build adds nothing, the privacy words say what it counts, and the check of the live pages allows exactly that script. Mode manual: the build adds one script tag with webAnalyticsToken (32 hex characters, public). The words follow the mode; the build and the live check refuse what the mode does not allow. excludeEu is a statement about the Cloudflare setting, which the build cannot see: set it to true only after choosing that option in the dashboard.
